seo.title: Privacy Notice — Eneon Technologies
seo.description: How the Eneon Technologies website and project enquiry form handle information.

hero.title: Privacy *notice.*
hero.lede: How the Eneon Technologies website handles information.

sections.heading: Website information
sections.text:
This website does not use advertising trackers, cookies or user accounts. To understand how the site is used, we keep anonymous visit statistics on our own systems: the pages viewed, time spent on them, how the site was reached (for example a search engine or a shared link), the general type of device and browser, the approximate country, and actions such as opening a project photo or tapping the WhatsApp button. We do not store IP addresses or anything that identifies you; visits are counted with a code that changes every day, and your browser keeps only a short note of the current visit and whether you have been here before. These statistics are not shared with or sold to anyone.

Images and video are delivered through Cloudinary, a media delivery network, which receives standard technical request information (such as IP address and browser type) in order to serve those files. Your light or dark theme choice is stored only in your own browser.

sections.heading: Project enquiries
sections.text: When you submit the enquiry form, your email application opens with the details you entered, addressed to Eneon Technologies. Nothing is sent until you choose to send that email. We use the information you provide only to respond to your enquiry and discuss a potential project.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.text: For privacy questions or to ask us to delete information you have shared, email privacy@eneontechnologies.com.
